summary: TASK-AR-588 replaces ad hoc dependency/state-machine/live-map graph positioning with locally served vendored Dagre/d3-force runtime layout engines, token-driven SVG helpers, status badges, magnitude edges, health edges, and a mobile layout overflow guard.
implemented: Vendored @dagrejs/dagre 3.0.0 under src/agent_runtime/vendor/dagre/3.0.0 and served /vendor/dagre/3.0.0/dagre.min.js from ui_console.py.
Vendored d3-force 3.0.0 plus UMD dependencies d3-quadtree 3.0.1, d3-dispatch 3.0.1, and d3-timer 3.0.1 under src/agent_runtime/vendor and served them from ui_console.py.
Added patternSvgLayeredDagreLayout for dependency and state-machine SVG layout; it now prefers the actual window.dagre runtime and falls back only if the vendored runtime is unavailable.
Added patternSvgForceAgentLayout for live agent map SVG layout; it now prefers the actual window.d3.forceSimulation runtime and falls back only if the vendored runtime is unavailable.
Added graphStatusIconText and shared graph health/magnitude/status helpers.
Rendered dependency, state-machine, and live-map edges with magnitude and health token classes.
Rendered per-node status badges/icons so status is not color-only.
Added .layout > * min/max width guard after browser verification exposed mobile horizontal overflow from intrinsic grid widths.
